2609.01556.title: Retrieved but not ranked: surface-form bias in structural retrieval, from mathematics to agent trajectories
2609.01556.paper_summary: We evaluate embedding retrieval where surface form and meaning are pulled apart on purpose: retrieving items that share underlying structure but not wording, in two unrelated domains under one protocol, competition mathematics (MathNet-Retrieve; 500 queries, 117,088-item corpus) and embodied-agent trajectories (ALFWorld-derived; 118 queries, 336 trajectories). In mathematics the failure is complete: strict Hit@1 at the heaviest disguise tier is 0.0% for both production embedders (bootstrap 95% CI [0.0, 0.0]) while the correct item sits in the top 10 nearly always, and in 95.2 to 99.8% of misses the winner is more lexically similar to the query than the correct answer. In trajectories, where surface variation is incidental, the same models land at or near hypergeometric chance when gold must involve a different object, and below chance for all three embedders once gold must differ in object and receptacle: retrieval anchors on literal tokens, not task structure. A lexical reranker control hurts in mathematics and helps in trajectories (closing 26 to 36% of the gap, CIs excluding zero); its sign reveals whether a benchmark's surface variation is adversarial or incidental. An LLM reranker recovers 5 to 63% of the gap in mathematics and 43 to 76% in trajectories; direction replicates across three judges (all 21 cells positive), but effect sizes, tier profiles, and the outlier judge change with domain (paired differences excluding zero everywhere). Mathematics gains concentrate on well-known competitions (+19.8 points, CI [+6.7, +33.2], one of six cells), so part of the recovery is memorization. In a paired downstream experiment (210 queries, graders at 96 to 99% agreement), oracle retrieval was indistinguishable from adversarially bad retrieval (McNemar p = 0.678); the solver's 69.5% zero-shot accuracy is largely a truncation proxy (97 to 100% on finished answers), leaving no headroom.
2609.01556.paper_summary_zh: 我們評估嵌入檢索，其中表面形式和意義故意分開：在一個協議下檢索具有相同基礎結構但不共享措辭的項目，涉及兩個無關的領域，競爭數學（MathNet-Retrieve；500個查詢，117,088項目語料庫）和具身代理軌跡（基於ALFWorld；118個查詢，336條軌跡）。在數學中，失敗是徹底的：在最重的偽裝層級，兩個生產嵌入器的嚴格Hit@1為0.0%（自助法95%置信區間[0.0, 0.0]），而正確項目幾乎總是在前10名中，並且在95.2%到99.8%的錯誤中，獲勝者在詞彙上與查詢更相似，而不是正確答案。在軌跡中，表面變異是偶然的，當金標必須涉及不同的對象時，相同的模型在超幾何機會附近落地，而當金標必須在對象和容器上有所不同時，三個嵌入器的表現均低於機會：檢索依賴於字面標記，而非任務結構。一個詞彙重排序控制在數學中造成損害，而在軌跡中則有幫助（縮小26%至36%的差距，置信區間不包括零）；其符號顯示基準的表面變異是對抗性的還是偶然的。一個LLM重排序器在數學中恢復了5%至63%的差距，在軌跡中恢復了43%至76%；方向在三位評審中重複（所有21個單元為正），但效應大小、層級特徵和異常評審隨著領域而變化（配對差異處處不包括零）。數學增益集中在知名競賽上（+19.8分，置信區間[+6.7, +33.2]，六個單元之一），因此部分恢復是記憶。在一個配對的下游實驗中（210個查詢，評分者達到96%至99%的一致），神諭檢索與對抗性差檢索無法區分（McNemar p = 0.678）；解決者的69.5%零樣本準確率在很大程度上是一個截斷代理（完成答案的準確率為97%至100%），沒有留下任何頭寸。
